title: traffic-semaphore-and-rollout-stability-notebook
summary: Compact working tracker that maps traffic-semaphore states to KPI triggers and owner runbooks for first-72h post-rollout. Designed to be a lightweight single-pane for oncall, product, and infra during phased launches.
readiness_checklist: Feature flag gating configured and tested in staging + canary (toggle id: ff/rollout/v2)
Canary routing path validated: region eu-west-1 -> dedicated-canary-1 -> fallback hosted-a
Latency smoke tests passing: p50 < target_p50 (see KPI table)
End-to-end privacy review completed for customer data paths (DPO signoff)
Audit logging enabled and retained per enterprise SLA (30 days)
traffic_semaphore: Green = steady-state: no gating; Yellow = slow-roll: limit new cohorts to 25%, increase telemetry cadence to 15min; Red = rollback or pause: drain canary and shift traffic to fallback model/region. Thresholds are driven by KPI alert expressions in KPI table. Use the following quick actions: GREEN -> continue ramp per plan; YELLOW -> hold new invites, spawn incident channel #rollout-watch, run targeted latency profiling; RED -> execute rollback-runbook v1.3 and notify exec ops.
traffic_tiers_and_actions: Tier 0 (preflight): internal smoke only, 0% external traffic
Tier 1 (canary): 1% external traffic, monitoring every 5 minutes, ops on-call in-channel
Tier 2 (slow-roll): 5-25% external traffic, cadence: 15-minute checks, enable extra caching/prefetch rules
Tier 3 (scale): >25% up to planned max, 30-minute dashboard checks, enable cost-optimization suggestions
notes: Notes to self: keep a short list of 3 quick prompts to test output quality post-rollout (sanity prompts) and capture 20 samples per hour during canary.
